title: Scalaris: A Scalable Enterprise Memory Architecture for Conversational AI Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2611.02612v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise conversational systems require memory to personalize interactions, retain information across sessions, and maintain conversational coherence. At enterprise scale, however, memory must not only retrieve relevant information accurately but also provide it efficiently to the answer-generation model. Existing memory systems face a trade-off between retrieval accuracy and context efficiency. Retrieving more context can improve recall but increases inference cost and latency. translated_title: Scalaris：一种面向对话式AI助手的可扩展企业级记忆架构
translated_abstract: 企业级对话系统需要记忆功能来个性化交互、跨会话保留信息，并维持对话的连贯性。然而，在企业规模下，记忆系统不仅要能够准确检索相关信息，还必须高效地将这些信息提供给答案生成模型。现有的记忆系统面临检索准确性与上下文效率之间的权衡：检索更多的上下文可以提高召回率，但会增加推理成本和延迟。我们提出了Scalaris，这是一种可扩展的企业级记忆架构，通过统一的长期与短期记忆设计来解决这一权衡问题。我们提出，用户交互和助手回复在对话中具有不同的特征和角色：用户交互捕获关于用户的不断演变的知识，并在跨会话中提供价值；而助手回复则必须被高效地存储，以便仅保留与当前……（摘要截断）
tldr: Scalaris是一种通过统一的长期与短期记忆设计，解决企业级对话AI系统中检索准确性与上下文效率之间权衡问题的可扩展记忆架构。
en_tdlr: Scalaris is a scalable enterprise memory architecture that addresses the trade-off between retrieval accuracy and context efficiency in conversational AI systems through a unified long-term and short-term memory design.
